post.originalText:
WHY are the humps on the wrong side?! 😭🐪

Asked Claude Opus 5.5 for a camel. Got a desert hopper with four legs pointing at the sky and two humps doing all the work. $10.75 well spent

It’s bouncing past palm trees like someone assembled a camel without reading the instructions. The legs are still there. They’re just management now

Then I made it pink, because apparently the anatomy wasn’t enough of a problem
